limitations: No claim of semantic or statistical independence. All cases are AI-authored; finite policy branches necessarily recur. Distinct histories and instants prevent literal or uniform-date-translation copies but do not create new business-policy rules.

normalization.rule_shape: Discard exact timestamp distances and history multiplicity; retain order/carrier states, temporal age band and policy predicate truth values. Overlap is expected under one fixed policy and is not evidence of new rule families.
normalization.substantive: Remove IDs, versions, all free text and exact nonterminal code spellings. Retain business states, exception truthiness, identifier relation, annotation actions, contradiction flag, normalized absolute UTC instants and ordered event-history shape.
normalization.translation: Apply substantive normalization, then express every aware instant relative to as_of using exact integer microseconds. Treat absent and naive values distinctly; retain naive civil offsets separately.

scope: All current tracked scenario JSON; manifest input cutoff projection only. Manifest case_id, family, action, final state, faults, counts, and all previous results/protocols were not accessed.
